reason: The plugin is primarily a memory/context plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it mounts a local Markdown folder as long-term memory, indexes entries from a file like MEMORY.md, and injects that context into prompts so the model can read specific memory files on demand. Evidence from the README and package description consistently centers on filesystem-based memory recall and session-based refresh behavior, with current limitations on write support and recursive indexing acknowledged.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness 的长时记忆插件：将本地 Markdown 文件夹按索引挂载为上下文，在系统提示中注入记忆索引，并按需读取对应的记忆文件。
summaries.en: This plugin for DeepSeek Harness mounts a local Markdown folder as long-term memory, injects an index into prompts, and lets the model read referenced memory files on demand.

capabilities: Reads markdown memory facts from a user-specified local directory.
Injects a memory index/listing block into the model system prompt.
Allows on-demand reading of referenced memory files during a session.
Refreshes memory snapshot at session start from filesystem state.
